svg.title: Four-Bit Wonder blank-board socket layout
svg.desc: Approximate scaled DIP socket plan for the base machine and Phase 1 and 2 additions.
svg.text: Core build: 28 sockets. Placement plan only; circuit wiring follows in a separate schematic.

g.text: Footprints scale by DIP pin pairs. Keep 100nF decouplers at IC sockets; use P0-P5 for resistor, timing, bulk, and control passives.
